input.summary: Use Wildcard and the Movie scoop to start LAH 6-Ball, extend it with switch waves and one captive-ball reset, then use M-Ball and stacked Dynamite Features to progress toward World Premiere.

quickInfo.name: LAH 6-Ball
quickInfo.summary: Collect LAST, ACTION, and HERO at the Movie scoop to start the timed six-ball feature.

quickInfo.name: Dynamite Feature
quickInfo.summary: A lit feature starts at the scoop and can stack with normal M-Ball.

quickInfo.name: M-Ball
quickInfo.summary: Advance the captive ball eight times, start at the Movie scoop, and collect ramp jackpots.

quickInfo.name: Smart Missile
quickInfo.summary: The cabinet button spots a lit feature shot or awards the listed multiball value.

quickInfo.name: World Premiere
quickInfo.summary: Play all ten regular Dynamite features and LAH 6-Ball to light the final scoop feature.

steps.text: Use the moving skill-shot indicator to plunge a lit C-R-A-N-E drop. Watch the Crane return before you chase locks.
At each ball start, shoot the Movie scoop and take the free feature selection.
Shoot the Wildcard scoop to select a missing LAST, ACTION, or HERO word. Shoot the left ramp to relight the Movie scoop.
modeNotes: Wildcard: The scoop lets you choose one missing title word and can double a running feature award.

steps.text: Shoot the Movie scoop to collect the selected word. Repeat until LAST, ACTION, and HERO are complete.
Collect the third word at the Movie scoop to start LAH 6-Ball.
modeNotes: LAH 6-Ball: Six balls play for about 25 seconds with an unlimited save until the timer expires.

steps.text: Hit the spinner and pop bumpers until the display completes each 50-switch wave.
modeNotes: Switch wave: Each completed wave adds about eight seconds and raises the stored World Premiere value.

steps.text: Hit the left captive ball once to reset the active timed feature to its maximum time.
After the timer ends, let the game drain the extra balls. Resume M-Ball and Dynamite progress with the remaining ball.
Start a Dynamite Feature at the Movie scoop before M-Ball when both are ready. During the extra-ball protection, follow the display for the active feature's required shots.
modeNotes: Dynamite Feature: One of ten timed modes starts at the Movie scoop and can run during normal multiball.

fallback.title: Recovery: M-Ball jackpot route
fallback.when: Recovery pivot: Use this when the title-word route is too far away.

steps.text: Roll through an inlane to light 2x M-Ball Advance.
Hit the captive ball while 2x is lit; the first M-Ball normally needs eight advances.
Start M-Ball at the Movie scoop.
Shoot the ramp for Jackpot, then shoot the timed Crane for Double Jackpot.
After enough jackpots, spell B-A-D-G-E and shoot the Crane, then the ramp, for the Super sequence.
Stop forcing the Crane if its return is unstable.

alternatives.title: Position play: Dynamite and M-Ball stack
alternatives.when: When trailing, use this higher-ceiling route: use this when one Dynamite Feature and M-Ball are both ready.

steps.text: Start the safer Dynamite Feature at the Movie scoop.
Start M-Ball before the feature timer expires.
Favor shots lit for both the feature and Jackpot.
Use one captive-ball hit to reset the active feature timer.

alternatives.title: Crane locks and Smart Missile
alternatives.when: Use this when the Crane feed and cabinet button awards are useful.

steps.text: Complete C-R-A-N-E and lock balls at the Crane.
Use Smart Missile during a difficult lit feature shot.
Do not spend Smart Missile on an award that settings have disabled.
Start or complete all ten regular Dynamite Features.
Start LAH 6-Ball and increase its stored value with target hits.
Shoot the Movie scoop when World Premiere lights.
Repeat the scoop to build the audience and collect the final value.
World Premiere is the wizard objective.

playfieldReferences.label: Movie Screen scoop
playfieldReferences.description: The upper-middle scoop starts Dynamite Features, M-Ball, LAH 6-Ball, and World Premiere when lit.

playfieldReferences.label: Wildcard scoop
playfieldReferences.description: The right-side scoop selects a missing LAST, ACTION, or HERO word and can double some active modes.

playfieldReferences.label: Left captive ball
playfieldReferences.description: The lower-left captive ball advances M-Ball and resets one active mode timer once.

playfieldReferences.label: Right captive ball
playfieldReferences.description: The upper-right captive ball advances M-Ball and is used during Go to the Movies.

playfieldReferences.label: C-R-A-N-E drop bank
playfieldReferences.description: The left-side bank supplies the moving skill shot and qualifies the Crane lock.

playfieldReferences.label: Crane shot and lock
playfieldReferences.description: The shot just right of the ramp collects Crane awards and locks up to two balls for M-Ball.

playfieldReferences.label: Roof ramp
playfieldReferences.description: The upper-left ramp relights the Movie scoop and collects M-Ball jackpots.

playfieldReferences.label: Lt. Dekker spinner
playfieldReferences.description: The spinner beside the Movie scoop feeds the pop bumpers and supplies LAH switch waves.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm Last Action Hero CPU 1.12 and display 1.06, then read feature timers, lock count, ball save, Extra Ball, and Special settings.
Verify the Crane, C-R-A-N-E bank, both captive balls, three scoops, Smart Missile, spinner, magnets, and Movie-scoop feature order.
Test Movie and Ripper kickouts, ramp diversions, Crane returns, scoop feeds, outlane saves, tilt sensitivity, and flipper strength.

techniques.name: Captive-ball timer reset
techniques.instruction: Hit the left captive ball once to reset an active timed feature to its maximum time.

techniques.name: Wildcard doubler
techniques.instruction: Use the Wildcard scoop during a valuable running feature to double its award when available.

techniques.name: Lit-inlane M-Ball advance
techniques.instruction: Roll through an inlane, then hit the captive ball before the 2x advance lamp expires.

cautions.issue: The Ripper kickout can return the ball at high speed.
cautions.response: Keep both flippers ready and watch one kickout before you repeat the scoop.

cautions.issue: The Danger Bar can reset the C-R-A-N-E drops.
cautions.response: Finish the moving skill shot or Crane bank before another bar hit when possible.

cautions.issue: A weak Crane shot can fall back into the upper playfield.
cautions.response: Use a full controlled shot and prepare for an unpredictable return after a reject.

input.simpleOverview: Last Action Hero uses the Movie scoop to collect LAST, ACTION, and HERO, with the third word starting timed six-ball play. Select missing words at Wildcard, relight the scoop at the left ramp, then extend LAH 6-Ball through switch waves and one captive-ball timer reset.
input.overview: Last Action Hero uses the Movie scoop to collect LAST, ACTION, and HERO, with the third word starting timed six-ball play. Collect LAST, ACTION, and HERO for the six-ball start, reset its timer once at the captive ball, then stack later Dynamite Features with M-Ball. Complete all features and return to the Movie scoop.

Test Movie and Ripper kickouts, ramp diversions, Crane returns, scoop feeds, outlane saves, tilt sensitivity, and flipper strength.
